fee_waiver.value: GRS waivers are for US citizens/permanent residents only; non-US applicants can request a program waiver in exceptional circumstances.

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact faculty; the program includes lab rotations.
supervisor.quote: Yes, it is recommended that you contact one or more faculty with whom you might wish to work. The Program requires laboratory rotations

funding.value: Admitted PhD students are eligible for up to five years of aid covering tuition, stipend and health insurance.
funding.quote: Newly admitted domestic and international students are eligible to receive up to five years of fellowship aid, contingent on satisfactory performance in the program. This includes tuition, a stipend, and health insurance.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough; an MS is not needed.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the MS or PhD programs must have completed a bachelor’s degree. An MS degree is not needed to apply to our PhD program.
